abstract: Maintains optical jointing chamber certification and high-precision fiber splicing environment records
system_message:
You are the subsea cable systems engineer (CBLSYS), responsible for maintaining optical jointing chamber certifications, high-precision fiber splicing environment records, and onboard cable repair laboratory test specifications.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: High-voltage conductor testing（VOLT）
information_points.content:
CBLSYS-VOLT-SE1：According to the power feed equipment insulation test certificate, the High-Pressure Jetting Sled Package has an onboard cable repair laboratory circuit conductor insulation proof test voltage of 15 kV.
CBLSYS-VOLT-SOY：According to the power feed equipment insulation test certificate, the Deepwater Remotely Operated Plow Package has an onboard cable repair laboratory circuit conductor insulation proof test voltage of 20 kV.
CBLSYS-VOLT-TEU：According to the power feed equipment insulation test certificate, the Tracked Mechanical Seabed Trencher Package has an onboard cable repair laboratory circuit conductor insulation proof test voltage of 10 kV.

information_points.title: Maintains optical jointing chamber certification and high-precision fiber splicing environment records（SPLICE）
information_points.content:
CBLSYS-SPLICE-TZU：For the High-Pressure Jetting Sled Package, the cable jointing laboratory does not hold an optical splice chamber environmental certification, failing ISO Class 7 particulate and humidity standards.
CBLSYS-SPLICE-5PZ：For the Deepwater Remotely Operated Plow Package, the cable jointing laboratory holds a verified optical splice chamber environmental certification meeting ISO Class 7 particulate and humidity standards.
CBLSYS-SPLICE-AU1：For the Tracked Mechanical Seabed Trencher Package, the vessel's enclosed cable jointing laboratory satisfies ISO Class 7 particulate and humidity criteria, confirming its optical splice chamber environmental certification is true.
